instruction: Right now you're facing towards a wall. Now turn behind and exit the room through the open door which is in front of you. Now turn right, there is an arch in front of you, move towards the arch and enter in to the room. Now turn right, there is an arch in front of you, move towards the arch and pass through the arch. Now slightly turn left, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and turn left. Now enter in to the room and slightly turn right. There is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room and stand in front of the bath tub and it is your end point.
